audit.whatIsWrong: Page rates it FAVOURED 4/10 and gives Pantheon all 7 chart rows, yet Pantheon wins only 47.64%.
audit.why: Early lane is genuinely Pantheon's (she is immobile, mana-hungry, weak bases), but her Transcendent-upgraded scaling and 80s-cd execute R take over at two items. Flipped the 2+ items row to Syndra; earlier rows left as Pantheon since the kit supports them.
Spikes: level 2 W all-in, level 6 Starfall vs her Unleashed Power, first item Eclipse, her two-item takeover — all present in spikes[] and phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and never mentioned that Scatter the Weak cancels your Aegis Assault channel; twelve fields misgender Syndra as he/his.
audit.why: Her E is a flat 15s and is hard CC, so it interrupts Aegis Assault's channel (missingInteractions rule your-channel-punished). Her R is 120/100/80 and executes. Grounded numbers and the channel-cancel into the cooldowns field; fixed every pronoun lint hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her P true damage and W true damage make resist-stacking wrong (missingInteractions resistances-invalidated); page never says it.
audit.why: Transcendent gives Force of Will bonus true damage — MR does not answer her W. Could not fit it without exceeding the report-edit budget already spent on lint fixes; recorded here.
